keyWork.en: Proof that the Riemann zeta function has infinitely many zeros on the critical line
keyWork.zh: 证明黎曼 ζ 函数在临界线上有无穷多个零点

why.en: Hardy's two defining partnerships both started by letter: a 35-year collaboration with J. E. Littlewood from 1911, and in 1913 a packet of formulas from an unknown clerk in Madras that he took seriously when others had not answered. With them he made Cambridge a centre of analytic number theory.
why.zh: 哈代一生最重要的两段合作都从书信开始：1911 年起与李特尔伍德合作了 35 年；1913 年，马德拉斯一个无名职员寄来一沓公式，别人没有回信，他却认真读了。靠这两段合作，剑桥成了解析数论的中心。

summary.en: Hardy was born in Cranleigh, Surrey, went to Winchester, and entered Trinity College, Cambridge, in 1896. His textbook A Course of Pure Mathematics (1908) brought continental rigour into English teaching. From 1911 he worked with Littlewood, and from 1914 with Ramanujan, on primes, partitions and Diophantine problems; the circle method came out of this work. He held the Savilian chair at Oxford from 1919 and returned to Cambridge in 1931. In 1940 he wrote A Mathematician's Apology, a short defence of pure mathematics; he died in 1947.
summary.zh: 哈代生于萨里郡的克兰利，读温切斯特公学，1896 年进入剑桥三一学院。1908 年出版的《纯粹数学教程》把欧陆的严格分析带进了英国的数学教学。1911 年起他与李特尔伍德合作，1914 年起又与拉马努金合作，研究素数、分拆和丢番图问题，圆法就出自这些工作。1919 年他去牛津任萨维尔讲座教授，1931 年回到剑桥。1940 年他写了《一个数学家的辩白》，为纯粹数学辩护。1947 年去世。

style.en: He kept a fixed routine: mathematics from 9 to 1, a light lunch, then the afternoon at the university cricket ground; out of season he read the Australian cricket scores in The Times and played real tennis.
style.zh: 他作息固定：上午九点到一点做数学，简单吃过午饭，下午去大学板球场看球；不是板球季，就看《泰晤士报》上的澳大利亚板球比分，打室内网球。

style.en: He could not stand being photographed, and only five snapshots of him are known. In hotel rooms his first act was to cover the mirror with a towel.
style.zh: 他受不了被拍照，已知的照片只有五张。住进旅馆，第一件事是用毛巾把镜子盖上。

style.en: A declared atheist, he played games of trying to fool God: before sailing home from Denmark he sent a postcard claiming he had proved the Riemann hypothesis, reasoning that God would not let the boat sink and give him the same fame as Fermat.
style.zh: 他自称无神论者，却总和上帝斗智。一次从丹麦坐船回国前，他寄出明信片，声称自己证明了黎曼猜想。他的理由是：上帝不会让船沉掉，让他像费马那样留下一桩悬案而出名。

timeline.en: Born in Cranleigh, Surrey, on 7 February.
timeline.zh: 2 月 7 日生于萨里郡克兰利。

timeline.en: Enters Trinity College, Cambridge, on a scholarship from Winchester.
timeline.zh: 从温切斯特公学获奖学金进入剑桥三一学院。

timeline.en: Publishes A Course of Pure Mathematics.
Begins his collaboration with J. E. Littlewood.
timeline.zh: 开始与李特尔伍德合作。

timeline.en: Receives Ramanujan's first letter from Madras.
timeline.zh: 收到拉马努金从马德拉斯寄来的第一封信。

timeline.en: Moves to Oxford as Savilian Professor of Geometry.
timeline.zh: 到牛津任萨维尔几何学讲座教授。

timeline.en: Returns to Cambridge as Sadleirian Professor.
timeline.zh: 回剑桥任萨德勒讲座教授。

works.title: A Course of Pure Mathematics
works.en: Taught generations of British students analysis with proper limits and rigour.
works.zh: 用严格的极限理论教分析，影响了几代英国学生。

works.title: Sur les zéros de la fonction ζ(s) de Riemann
works.en: The first proof that infinitely many zeros of the zeta function lie on the critical line.
works.zh: 第一次证明 ζ 函数有无穷多个零点落在临界线上。

works.title: Some problems of 'Partitio numerorum' (with J. E. Littlewood)
works.en: The series that turned the circle method into a general tool for Waring's and Goldbach's problems.
works.zh: 这组论文把圆法发展成处理华林问题、哥德巴赫问题的通用工具。

works.title: A Mathematician's Apology
works.en: A short essay on why pure mathematics is worth doing, written when he felt his creative years were over.
works.zh: 一本谈纯粹数学为何值得做的小书，写于他自觉创造力已经耗尽之时。

quotes.text: The mathematician's patterns, like those of the painter's or the poet's, must be beautiful, the ideas, like the colours or the words, must fit together in a harmonious way. There is no permanent place in the world for ugly mathematics.
quotes.zh: 数学家的模式，和画家、诗人的一样，必须是美的；思想要像颜色和词语那样和谐地组合在一起。丑陋的数学在世上没有立足之地。
quotes.source: A Mathematician's Apology, 1940, quoted in the MacTutor biography

links.title: Reviews of G H Hardy's Apology
The man who taught infinity: how GH Hardy tamed Srinivasa Ramanujan's genius

lessons.en: Hardy did his best work in two long partnerships. He also read an unsolicited letter from an unknown clerk to the end. Take seriously work from outside your circle.
lessons.zh: 哈代最好的工作出自两段长期合作。他也会把一个无名职员的来信认真读完。对圈子外寄来的东西，也要认真看。

lessons.en: His Course of Pure Mathematics and his Apology shaped how people learned and thought about mathematics. Write the textbook your field is missing.
lessons.zh: 《纯粹数学教程》和《一个数学家的辩白》改变了人们学数学、看数学的方式。你的领域缺什么书，就去写。
